title: The verifier's releases under a live rolling definition whose only tier is Tier 0 (definition version 7, electorate_mode 2, results_mode live; ballot version 5): a sealed poll with two scheduled snapshots, forty honest ballots in two batches of live_batch, every registered seat's receipts, the release of snapshot 1 with each registered seat's running opening, and the final tally, with the rows and report a verifier gives
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/verifier-ballots-v5-tier0-live-vectors.py, from verifier-ballots-v5-tier0-sealed-vectors.py, running-opening-vectors.py, live-verifier-vectors.py and the modules they load (independent Python implementations; every step root is rebuilt there from the listed groups' events, every L1 header encoded there, and the release report computed by live-verifier-vectors.py's model); membership proofs by packages/crypto/scripts/ballot-proofs.mjs, run outside the workspace with Semaphore 4.14.3's depth-32 circuit artifacts and snarkjs 0.7.5, whose groth16.verify gives every pairing verdict on the signals derived here from each record
description: A live rolling poll (live_every 1, live_batch 20) opening in period 1 and closing in period 3, so with scheduled snapshots at segments 1 and 2. Tier 0 is group 1: 38 members at opening, two added during the poll. Segment 0: the transcript. Segment 1: twenty opening members' ballots at step M, naming a block before snapshot 1's head, at which M is final, each with every registered seat's receipt. Segment 2: the other eighteen opening members' and the two joiners' ballots at step M + 6, naming a block above snapshot 1's head, with their receipts. The decision at snapshot 2 releases snapshot 1 (twenty entries since opening, twenty after); segment 3 holds each registered seat's running opening of it, segment 4 each registered seat's opening of the final tally over all forty. The final tally against the release has d = 20, the ballots that entered after it.
